_published_faq.name: How do I add Fleet connected tools to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fleet connected tools to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fleet-mcp-baseline.oedum.chatgpt.site/connected-tools.

_published_faq.name: Is Fleet connected tools MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, Fleet connected tools scores 82/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.
